status: Closed — fixed in ATM-GOV-0416; runtime-only raw journal and tracked digest receipt verified
finding: ATM dogfood still exposes raw telemetry and shell-usage habits at the wrong layer: pre-push diagnostics expect .atm/history/evidence/git-head.jsonl even when the operator intentionally keeps raw JSONL out of Git, and first-layer skills do not reliably prevent Windows PowerShell text-IO/range examples that repeatedly trip agents.
expectedBehavior: Raw statistics, counters, logs, and detailed telemetry should remain on disk under gitignored runtime/log surfaces; Git should contain only compact digest or decision evidence. First-layer ATM skills should disclose the correct CLI surfaces and safe shell conventions early enough that agents do not need to rediscover them through trial-and-error.
evidenceOrRepro: The safe-shell and first-layer CLI portion was verified by `first-layer-command-contracts.test.ts`, `first-layer-ux-routing.test.ts`, and `validate-guide.ts`. ATM-GOV-0416 then implemented the remaining policy: raw git-head JSONL is runtime-only, the tracked receipt contains compact digest/decision evidence, and the acceptance boundary remains strict. `git-head-runtime-only-receipt.test.ts`, `git-head-admission-owner-boundary.test.ts`, `npm run validate:git-head-evidence`, `npm run validate:cli:surface`, `npm run typecheck`, and the governed push all passed on 2026-09-06.
followUp: Keep the runtime raw journal ignored and the tracked receipt compact and digest-verifiable. Future git-head changes must preserve the runtime-only storage policy and the focused owner-boundary regression.
